issues.title: Archipelago logic play-test
issues.author: Lynder063
issues.body:
Help check the Archipelago and item randomizer logic. Each line is one question: can you get it without the item?
Play with the item randomizer or the Archipelago mod. Its spoiler tells you what you hold. Reply with the line and yes/no.
Trespasser

 Veldin (return): reach and beat Drek without the Trespasser
 Veldin (return): gold bolt 1 without the Trespasser
 Aridia: gold bolt 4 without the Trespasser
 Batalia: gold bolt 2 without the Trespasser
 Eudora: the warp pad (Suck Cannon) and the…
